fieldValues.title: 9. Learn and remember: what we tried and where we went too far
fieldValues.thinking_reached:
The ideal: What happened is reported, measured and ratified, and the practice and its one statement change because of it, so the next session starts from it.

What we have tried: Run reports and session reports; srs-context and the dream cycle; the handbook as records with a watcher; indicators (I1 grounding); retrospectives, the archaeology and the work-flow audit; CLAUDE.md pointers in every repository.

Problems recorded here: SP-65, SP-67, SP-68, SP-43, SP-69, SP-53, SP-104.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Line 2, Keep the practice stable and change it from each lesson (reframed 2026-10-25: 'Record and change the practice' failed the coupled-cost test): too far toward both, by turns. Day to day lessons are recorded and not applied (I2 to I4 never computed, falsifiers never evaluated); every few weeks the process is replaced whole (SP-114).
- Model B: process against product merges, week of 10-12 66 to 26, week of 10-19 197 to 83; I2 to I4 never computed; falsifiers never evaluated; 14 of 20 run reports say landed_as pending; no retrospective.
- The stage's other two tensions stay as records under its domain, out of this map (one trade-off per stage, owner, 2026-10-25).
fieldValues.unresolved_questions:
- The trade-off is untested: its four 2×2 cases are not filled yet.
